claims.claim: University of Melbourne researchers integrated cross-sectoral trade monitoring data and estimated at least 107,356 species are used and traded worldwide.

claims.claim: The START cis-regulatory element raised transcript levels 2.1-fold and editing efficiency at four Arabidopsis targets by about 1.8-fold.
claims.episode_span: They then introduced complementary mismatched bases into the reverse transcriptase templates of dual pegRNAs, producing the SmartPE system that lifted average editing activity more than sixfold to roughly 10 percent at four Arabidopsis targets.

claims.claim: Late-life administration of a three-component senolytic vaccine produced a 12 percent increase in median lifespan in female B6 mice.
claims.episode_span: Late-life administration of a three-component senolytic vaccine lowered senescence markers and produced a 12 percent increase in median lifespan in female B6 mice.

claims.supporting_quote: In a new study, late-life treatment with a three-element senolytic vaccine led to lower senescence markers and a 12% increase in median lifespan in female B6 mice.
